ads_full_text_blind_spot.finding: THE FOUR-FORM ADS QUERY MISSED TWO OF THE FOUR REFEREED PAPERS THAT CARRY THIS BURST'S NUMBERS.
ads_full_text_blind_spot.missed_1: Golkhou+2015 (2015ApJ...811...93G) prints '110928180' in Table 2 on arXiv PDF p.25, yet full:"110928180" returns numFound=0. Found instead by a PyMuPDF token scan of the 150 PDFs already in Skills_training/ - i.e. by the LOCAL CORPUS, not by ADS.
ads_full_text_blind_spot.missed_2: Maccary+2025 (2025A&A...702A..95M) carries the burst only in a machine-readable table (VizieR J/A+A/702/A95 table1, recno 671); the token appears nowhere in the 14-page PDF. Found by a web bridge (Phase 1b) -> VizieR row lookup.
ads_full_text_blind_spot.lesson: ADS full-text does not index long machine-readable/appendix tables reliably. For a burst with a thin ADS footprint, the four-form query is a FLOOR, not a census: it must be followed by (i) a local-corpus token scan and (ii) VizieR row lookups in the standard catalog series. Both are cheap and both paid out here.

finding: NO DEDICATED-ANALYSIS PAPER EXISTS for GRB 110928B / bn110928180, and ZERO GCN circulars were ever issued for it. The refereed footprint is 5 papers, all sample/catalog memberships: 2 GBM catalogs (von Kienlin+2014 machine-readable, Narayana Bhat+2016 with four PRINTED rows), 1 IPN supplement (Hurley+2017, 7-instrument detection + a 0.212 deg2 triangulated box, 3390x smaller than the GBM contour), and 2 MVT population papers (Golkhou+2015, Maccary+2025) whose two MVT estimators differ by ~15x BY DEFINITION. The single most consequential harvested fact is Narayana Bhat+2016's Table-6 footnote n - used exactly once in the whole catalog, on this burst: 'Localization of precursor at T0 -120 s is consistent with burst location and was included in the duration analysis.' Every published T90/fluence for this burst therefore covers PRECURSOR + MAIN, while our stamped window [-7.338, +30.455] s covers MAIN ONLY - the T9 component-coverage mismatch is the dominant diff hazard here. No redshift, no afterglow, no host, no photospheric or synchrotron advocacy anywhere in the record: a clean null-streak baseline burst.

vikas_reading_list: 15-minute item, in this order. (1) Maccary+2025 Sect. 2 ONLY (~2 pp): the three competing MVT definitions - read it before we quote any MVT for this burst, because Golkhou's <0.203 s and Maccary's 3.02 s are DIFFERENT QUANTITIES, not a disagreement. Defer their Sects. 4-6. (2) Narayana Bhat+2016 p.135 footnote block (10 lines) + Sect. 3.2 (~1 p): the precursor footnote that reframes T90 for this burst, and their detector rule (<60 deg, no blockage) which is our D5 stated in print. (3) Golkhou+2015 Sects. 2-3 skim IF we go after energy-dependent MVT. Nothing else needs reading - Hurley+2017 is three table rows (transcribed in the dossier) and von Kienlin+2014 has no printed row for us.
